Yes, those three all match what I want. Saving a new bookmark, tapping the title to open the real page, and going back through the menu to edit it later — all working the way I'd expect.

Two small things I noticed while we were in the editor, both tied to editing: when I edited, I could change the title and description, but the web address itself was shown as fixed. Every so often I paste a slightly wrong or messy link, so I'd want to be able to correct the address too, not just the title and description. And eventually I'll want to add my own tags there. Those can come whenever they fit your plan.

And the one thing from "saving" we still haven't actually tried is what happens when I save a link I already have — I'd want it to bring me to the existing one rather than make a duplicate. Otherwise, everything checked so far is right.
